name: One☆Lover!! ~Miku-chan no Koibito~
original_name: One☆らばー!! ～ミクちゃんの恋人～
source:
The protagonist of this story is Miku, an ordinary high school girl.

Her parents are often away on business trips due to their busy work schedules.
Seeing how lonely she seemed as a child, they decided to get her a dog as a companion.

After the adorable puppy came home, Miku quickly bonded with it and became a much brighter, happier child.
And they all lived happily ever after.

…Or so it seemed.

Years later, Miku is now a perfectly ordinary student attending a perfectly ordinary school.
She even has a perfectly ordinary boyfriend.

His name is Daisuke.

A perfectly ordinary boy and a perfectly ordinary girl,
sharing a perfectly ordinary romance.
Being at that age, their relationship has naturally progressed—
from A to B, and even to C.

They’re just your average couple, enjoying your average kind of love.

Except… there’s one thing that sets them apart from other couples…………??? (lol)

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ005273.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
这个故事的主角是Miku，一个普通的女高中生。

由于工作繁忙，她的父母经常出差。
看到她小时候如此孤独，他们决定给她养一只狗作为伴侣。

这只可爱的小狗回家后，Miku很快就和它建立了亲密的关系，并成为一个更加聪明、快乐的孩子。
他们从此过上了幸福的生活。

……或者看起来是这样。

多年后，Miku现在是一名非常普通的学生，就读于一所非常普通的学校。
她甚至还有一个非常普通的男朋友。

他的名字叫大辅。

一个极其普通的男孩和一个极其普通的女孩，
分享着一段极其平凡的浪漫。
到了那个年纪，他们的关系自然就发展了——
从A到B，甚至到C。

他们只是你们普通的夫妻，享受着你们普通的爱情。

除了……有一件事使他们与其他情侣不同…………？？？（笑）
